rw [comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero, comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero, (R.cyclesShortComplex_shortExact n).extClass_naturality (R'.cyclesShortComplex_shortExact n) (R.cyclesShortComplexMap f n)]
explanation: Mathlib proves naturality of the extension class for any map of short exact short complexes. Specializing to the cycle short complexes and reassociating Ext composition gives this naturality statement for the dimension-shift maps. The current proof instead uses the library's own `covariantDimensionShift_naturality` lemma.
